Super Advanced · Graph as Entity · Craft

The plan stays attached

A task can finish without losing the blueprint that called for it. Replay one materialization wave and inspect the durable trail before, during, and after work.

Solid ink — a real graph relationship Ghost ink — a blueprint spec, not an entity yet truth floor checked 2026-08-20

01Trace the born task home

Use Play, Step, or the timeline. Then select the task to read its record. Each control changes one thing; the relationships never disappear.

02Read the evidence two ways

The relationship view teaches the graph. The record view shows the same facts in the shape you inspect from the CLI.

  • task → attached_to → graph
    The durable backlink returns the real task to the graph and node handle that called for it.
  • message → anchored_to → graph
    Approval and progress live on the graph’s discussion thread; they are not transient animation labels.
  • work_session → working_on → task
    During execution, the running agent session works the materialized task.

03Keep the boundary honest

Craft writes the blueprint

Craft chat mode and the Craft tab are one graph-authoring feature. While you sketch, spec nodes stay dashed: no task and no board edge exists yet.

Agents make it real

After approval lands in the durable thread, an orchestrating agent reads the graph, creates the real entities, wires their relationships, and links them back.

Honest boundaryThe server does not walk the blueprint and materialize it by itself. The agent performs that work through the delegation surface.

The blueprint is not a detached document you archive after planning. It is the living provenance you can still follow when the work is done.
